Name: virtual shared chest
Author: ovozzz2
Description:
[b]模组描述  Description[/b]
给和我一样想在联机时和好友快速交换物品的玩家使用，在不破坏原版游戏体验的情况下实现玩家高效互动。单人游玩也可以当作一个额外的大背包使用。本模组由AI辅助完成，或者我辅助AI完成哈哈哈，感谢AI，我付费制作的，不可付费商用。付费使用的与我无关，我不会给模组收费。
For players like me who want to quickly exchange items with friends during multiplayer, this mod enables efficient player interaction without breaking the vanilla game experience. It can also be used as an extra large backpack in single-player.This mod was completed with AI assistance—or rather, I assisted AI, haha. Thanks to AI. I paid to have it made, and it may not be used commercially for a fee. Any paid use is unrelated to me; I will not charge for this mod.

[b]安装说明 Installation instructions[/b]
下载zip文件后解压放到游戏内mods文件夹中使用。
After downloading the ZIP file, extract it and place it in the game's Mods folder to use.

[b]主要功能 Main features[/b]
按键（默认F9）打开一个虚拟共享箱子，所有安装了这个模组的玩家可以随意放入或拿取箱内物品——和原版箱子一样使用，且没有延迟。
Press the key (default: F9) to open a virtual shared chest. All players who have this mod installed can freely place or take items from the chest—just like using a vanilla chest, with no delay.

[b]前置需求 Requirements[/b]
只需 SMAPI，不需要其他框架。如果安装了通用模组配置菜单（GMCM），可以在游戏内修改按键绑定；不安装也能正常使用这个模组。
SMAPI only—no other frameworks required. If the Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) is installed, you can change the keybind in-game; the mod still works without it.

[b]特别感谢 Shout outs[/b]
感谢AI让普通人也能制作自己喜欢的模组。
Thanks to AI, ordinary people can now make the mods they love.

Manifest.Name: 虚拟共享箱子virtual shared chest
Manifest.Description: 所有安装本模组的玩家可以打开一个共享箱子。界面与原版70 格大箱子一致，可自由放入、拿出任何物品（含工具），内容由房主端统一同步。All players who have this mod installed can open a shared chest. The interface is identical to the vanilla 70-slot large chest, and any items (including tools) can be freely placed in or taken out. The contents are synchronized centrally by the host.
Manifest.Author: ovozzz2
